title: Short item on the Meishan Renshou Half Marathon inside the report 'Tesfay goes No.2 all time with 2:10:51 marathon debut in Barcelona'

story.W: Ruti Aga won in 1:08:04, 29 seconds ahead of Tiantian Liang. The item does not describe how the race unfolded.
story.M: Alex Nzioka Matata won in 59:51, 56 seconds ahead of Gemechu Dida. The item does not describe how the race unfolded.

performances.name: Alex Nzioka MATATA
performances.note: Defended his title; he also won several half marathons the previous year.

performances.name: Ruti AGA
performances.note: Won on a winning streak that includes the Xiamen Marathon in January; the 2019 Tokyo Marathon champion.
